# openai_workload_identity_federation_rule (Resource)

Manage a workload identity federation rule for an existing project service account. This resource does not create API keys or exchange tokens.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_workload_identity_federation_rule" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id = "workload_identity_provider_123"
  project_id                    = "proj_123"
  service_account_id            = "service_account_123"
  attribute_matchers            = { repository = "openai/example", protected = true, repository_id = 9007199254740993 }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attribute_matchers` (Dynamic) Exact attribute matches. Values may be strings, booleans, or numbers; nulls and nested values are not accepted.
- `project_id` (String) project id
- `service_account_id` (String) service account id
- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) workload identity provider id

### Optional

- `description` (String) description
- `enabled` (Boolean) enabled
- `name` (String) name
- `permissions` (Attributes) Use service_account_default, or restricted with a nonempty list of scopes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) created at
- `id` (String) id
- `updated_at` (Number) updated at
- `workload_identity_federation_rule_id` (String) workload identity federation rule id

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `type` (String) type

Optional:

- `scopes` (List of String) scopes

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_workload_identity_federation_rule.example
  id = "workload_identity_provider_123/workload_identity_federation_rule_123"
}
```
